title: Pro-Palestine Protesters Raise Bloody Cry Outside Israeli Embassy in Washington**
text:
Pro-Palestine Protesters Raise Bloody Cry Outside Israeli Embassy in Washington**"

""
"Protesters gathered outside the Israeli embassy in Washington, D.C., pouring blood-red liquid, placing symbolic graves adorned with Palestinian flags, and displaying an image of Benjamin Netanyahu dancing on blood to voice their fury over the war in Gaza. "

"Placards bearing protest slogans such as "Israelis are child killers" and "Israel! The world hates you" were also seen among the crowd.
